description:
In this heartfelt episode of “I’d Like to Know”, Pastors Stephen Bohr, C.A. Murray, and David Salazar answer two powerful questions:

One from a struggling Adventist wife who longs to be faithful in tithing but is forbidden by her non-Christian husband, and another from a viewer seeking clarity on the timeline of Revelation 17:10 and the seven prophetic heads.

📘 Bible Questions Answered every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv — real struggles, real answers, rooted in Scripture.

⏱️ Timestamps & Questions:

02:44 – I want to tithe, but my husband forbids it. What should I do?
Can a wife honor God if she can’t give tithe due to her husband’s financial control? What does the Bible say about submission in marriage versus obedience to God? Is her salvation in question? The pastors respond with care, compassion, and biblical insight.

17:37 – Revelation 17:10 – How could John say 5 kings have fallen if Papal Rome came later?
Does the timeline of prophetic heads in Revelation 17 contradict John's time period? The team explains prophetic symbols, how to read the passage in context, and the flow of kingdoms leading to the end-time powers.

💬 Got a question? Drop it in the comments — it could be featured in a future episode!
